title: Maru Campos Assured Me Jáuregui Was Corrupt and a Casino Owner, Sheinbaum Says
author: Alonso Urrutia and Arturo Sánchez
content:
_This article by[Alonso Urrutia and Arturo
Sánchez](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Alonso%20Urrutia%20y%20Arturo%20S%C3%A1nchez.)
originally appeared in the [October 23, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/23/politica/maru-campos-
me-denuncio-que-jauregui-era-corrupto-y-era-dueno-de-casinos-sheinbaum),
Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. Confirming that she held a tense conversation with the
governor of Chihuahua, María Eugenia Campos, President Claudia Sheinbaum
revealed that in that talk the PAN politician denounced that the state's
former Attorney General of Justice, César Jáuregui, **was involved in acts of
corruption and was the owner of casinos**. In light of those accusations,
Sheinbaum said, she urged her to file the corresponding complaints.

At her press conference, the president acknowledged that Campos reproached her
for having accused her of treason, to which, Sheinbaum commented, she replied
that she had spoken about how **the Chihuahua authorities had allowed foreign
agents to participate in operations in Mexico**. She denied having questioned
Campos over the relationship with the United States having become complicated
because of these state actions.

Asked directly about the exchange over who was responsible for the
participation of foreign agents in the Chihuahua operation, Campos answered
Sheinbaum, the president said:

> It wasn't me, it was the prosecutor.
>
> María Eugenia Campos, according to President Sheinbaum

The President said she had suggested to her that, given this knowledge of
irregularities detected regarding Jáuregui, she could meet with the Attorney
General of the Republic, Ernestina Godoy, to make this situation known to her,
after which there was a meeting between Campos and Godoy.

![Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo at the podium of the Conferencia del Pueblo in
Mexico City](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/10/02-sheinbaum-conference.jpg)Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo.
Photo: Cuartoscuro

At her press conference, she recalled that her presence in Chihuahua was due
to her touring the country's 32 states to deliver her government report
throughout the country. Prior to this, Campos formally requested a private
meeting, for which reason Sheinbaum agreed to a meeting at the Ciudad Juárez
airport. Sheinbaum admitted that **it was not a meeting between friends, but
between the president and the governor**.

At the end of the meeting, Campos asked her what the terms of the relationship
would be going forward, to which she replied that it would be an institutional
relationship between both levels of government.
